answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 26 identities per epoch. Audits are recorded in violet, queued in mesa, and grove publishes the wait time. A farm of 334 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 4145 identities would post 2421 proofs and burn roughly 14 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
